decision.observation: 8:50 pm, rain. The farmer (purple hair, blue jacket) stands on the cobblestone plaza west of the Stardrop Saloon; lampposts line the south edge, and the saloon building is visible at the right edge.
decision.hypothesis: Heading east along the plaza toward the saloon front, then to the doorsteps, will allow entering the saloon for evening greetings.
decision.memory: Saloon door faces south-east on the building's front. Introductions 6/28; 450g; axe selected.
